newsitem.title: JORDAN: Second Iraq wheat cargo via Aqaba port next week.
newsitem.headline: Second Iraq wheat cargo via Aqaba port next week.

text.p: A second Iraq-bound cargo of 50,000 tonnes of French wheat to be shipped through Jordan under the oil-for-food deal is expected to dock at Aqaba port next Wednesday, Jordanian shippers said on Thursday.
They said the vessel was the second cargo from an original 102,500 tonnes of French wheat sold by Glencore.
The first vessel -- the Cypriot-flagged Malama, which arrived last Friday carrying 52,500 tonnes of French wheat -- had only 7,000 tonnes left of its cargo to be discharged, shippers said.
Aside from the two shipments, so far most of Baghdad's grain imports under the oil-for-food deal have been delivered to Um Qasr, Iraq's sole sea outlet.
Aqaba, built as a regional port, is a key unloading port under the deal, and officials and shippers hope at least 20 percent of the accord's purchases will be handled through it.
